# Bon Appétit

> > Bon Appétit is a comprehensive food media platform offering recipes, cooking guides, restaurant coverage, and food culture content for home cooks and food enthusiasts.

Bon Appétit combines practical culinary instruction with food journalism, featuring thousands of tested recipes, expert cooking advice, video tutorials, and dining guides across major U.S. cities. The site serves as both a recipe reference and a lifestyle publication exploring food trends, entertaining, and culinary travel.

## Recipe Collections

- [Recipes](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipes): Main recipe collection hub with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and vegetarian options
- [Cacio e Pepe (Classic Roman Cheese and Pepper Pasta) Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/cacio-e-pepe): Classic Roman pasta recipe with Pecorino, black pepper, and silky sauce
- [Easy Fish Curry With Coconut Milk Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/easy-fish-curry): Thai-style one-pan fish curry with coconut milk ready in under an hour
- [Jammy Egg Curry Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/jammy-egg-curry): Indian egg curry recipe from The Diaspora Spice Co. Cookbook
- [Plantain and Black Bean Salad Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/plantain-and-black-bean-salad): Jamaican-inspired vegetarian salad recipe perfect for meal prep
- [Broccoli Confetti Rice Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/broccoli-confetti-rice): Vegetarian broccoli rice salad with raisins and almonds for meal prep
- [Penne alla Nada Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/penne-alla-nada): Alcohol-free penne alla vodka recipe from Demi Lovato's cookbook
- [Vodka Biscuits Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/vodka-biscuits): Flaky biscuit recipe using vodka for tender crumb texture

## Cooking & Techniques

- [Cooking](https://www.bonappetit.com/cooking): Cooking hub with expert advice, seasonal recipes, and meal preparation tips
- [Videos](https://www.bonappetit.com/video): Video content including cooking techniques, chef interviews, and food documentaries
- [Dinner SOS by Bon Appétit | Cooking Podcast](https://www.bonappetit.com/podcast/dinner-sos): Cooking podcast with host Chris Morocco solving kitchen emergencies and recipe help
- [WTF Is a Weeknight Recipe?](https://www.bonappetit.com/story/what-is-a-weeknight-recipe): Editorial guide defining weeknight recipes and Bon Appétit's recipe standards

## Dining & Restaurants

- [Restaurants](https://www.bonappetit.com/restaurants): Dining guides and restaurant coverage for Brooklyn, LA, San Francisco, and more
- [Drinks](https://www.bonappetit.com/drinks): Drinks guide covering cocktails, wine, whiskey, and nonalcoholic beverages

## Food Culture & Entertainment

- [Culture](https://www.bonappetit.com/culture): Food culture, lifestyle, and trends covering pop culture and eating habits
- [Bon Appétit Culinary Getaways](https://www.bonappetit.com/story/culinary-getaways): Expert-guided culinary travel experiences to Japan, Thailand, and world destinations

## Shopping & Products

- [Shopping](https://www.bonappetit.com/shopping): Editor-curated kitchen tools, cookware, gadgets, and ingredient shopping guide
- [Bon Appétit Shop](https://shop.bonappetit.com): Merchandise store offering branded apparel, kitchen accessories, and gift items
